title: 第21章 流水不争先争的是滔滔不绝第22章 身体是渡世宝筏根基是武道长城
content_zh:
;;
众人看得目不转睛，眼睛也不敢眨一下。
他们知道，洪师傅是要传授绝技了。
下一刻，洪元动了。
他双臂猛地一震，十八铁环瞬间凝束，发出令人心惊肉跳的金铁碰撞之声！
他腰胯下沉，双脚踏地。
这一脚跺下，整个练武场的地面都微微一颤！
“霸王断江！”
一声暴喝，如同惊雷炸响。
洪元双臂交错狂舞，双拳犹如铁瓮般击出。
那砂锅大的拳头每一次轰出，都伴随狂暴风流，激荡而起。
那十八铁环在他双臂舞动间，化作了一道道狂暴的乌黑雷霆！
“啪啪！”
空气被蛮横地击破，发出激烈的音爆之声，劲风四溢，吹得周围弟子衣袂猎猎作响，几乎要站立不稳。
众人只觉得眼前，仿佛出现了一尊上古霸王，手持双斧，怒劈大江，要将那滔滔江河一分为二！
那股沛莫能御，断金裂石的恐怖气势，让不少弟子脸色发白。
这样的攻势，莫说是正面对战。
便是被拳风微微掠过，都得带层皮肉下来。
林青看得心驰神往，呼吸都不由自主地屏住。
他深切的感受到，这一式霸王断江，已将铁线拳刚猛暴烈的特性，发挥到了极致。

练到高深处，这一双缠绕铁环的手臂，简直堪比神兵利器，无坚不摧。其威力，绝不逊于那些专修外功的横练高手。
洪元演练完毕，收势而立，气息平稳。
仿佛刚才那石破天惊的一幕只是幻觉。
但空气中那令人心悸的压迫感，却久久不散。
一众弟子尚沉浸在震撼之中，鸦雀无声。
就在这时。
人群中，一道身影越众而出。
正是张顺！
与往日不同，此刻的张顺，眼神锐利。
周身气血澎湃，显然也已将状态调整至巅峰。
他深吸一口气，双臂一振！
“铮铮铮——！”
他手臂上的铁环也依次滑落，发出清脆的鸣响，虽然没有洪元那般举重若轻，却也气势不凡。
他回忆着洪元方才的运劲力度，和那股一往无前的霸烈意境，猛地踏前一步，双臂肌肉鼓胀，悍然挥出！
“哈！”
随即，张顺也使出霸王断江，拳风呼啸。
content_en:
;;
Everyone watched intently and did not dare to blink.
They knew that Master Hong was going to teach him some special skills.
The next moment, Hong Yuan moved.
His arms shook violently, and the eighteen iron rings condensed instantly, making a heart-stopping sound of gold and iron colliding!
His hips lowered and his feet touched the ground.
With this stamp of his foot, the ground of the entire martial arts training ground trembled slightly!
"Overlord cuts off the river!"
A loud shout was like a thunderous explosion.
Hong Yuan's arms crossed and danced wildly, and his fists were struck out like iron urns.
Every time the casserole-sized fist was blasted out, it was accompanied by violent wind and waves.
The eighteen iron rings turned into violent black thunder as his arms danced!
"Pop!"
The air was violently broken, making a fierce sonic boom sound, and strong winds overflowing, making the clothes of the surrounding disciples rustle, making them almost unsteady.
Everyone felt as if an ancient overlord appeared in front of them, holding two axes and slashing the river angrily, trying to split the surging river into two!
The terrifying aura that no one could control, breaking metal and cracking rocks, made many disciples turn pale.
Such an offensive cannot be said to be a head-on confrontation.
Even if it was slightly brushed by the wind of the fist, it would have to be covered with a layer of skin.
Lin Qing was fascinated by what she saw, and couldn't help but hold her breath.
He deeply felt that this style of Overlord Duanjiang had brought the iron wire fist's fierce and violent characteristics to its extreme.
After practicing to a high level, the pair of arms wrapped with iron rings can be compared to magical weapons, indestructible. Its power is by no means inferior to those who specialize in external martial arts.
Hong Yuan finished the drill and stood up with his posture calm.
It was as if the earth-shattering scene just now was just an illusion.
But the heart-stopping pressure in the air lingered for a long time.
All the disciples were still immersed in shock and remained silent.
Just then.
Among the crowd, a figure emerged from the crowd.
It's Zhang Shun!
Different from the past, Zhang Shun's eyes were sharp at this moment.
The energy and blood all over his body are surging, and his condition has obviously been adjusted to its peak.
He took a deep breath and raised his arms!
"Zhengzhengzheng——!"
The iron rings on his arms also slipped off one after another, making a crisp sound. Although he was not as light as Hong Yuan, he was still impressive.
He recalled Hong Yuan's strength just now, and his indomitable and domineering mood, and took a step forward, with the muscles in his arms bulging, and he swung out boldly!
"Ha!"
Immediately, Zhang Shun also used Bawang Duanjiang, and the fist wind roared.
